data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'bakarah', which means 'pure' or 'hallowed'. In Islamic tradition, this name represents the purity of heart and spirit, and is a reminder of the importance of striving for spiritual purification. The name Bakarah carries the meaning “Pure, Hallowed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bakarah usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, hallowed and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name is believed to evoke a sense of profound reverence and spiritual focus, inspiring the bearer to strive towards a life of piety, devotion, and self-purification.
